text: Current nsImapAddMsgFlags enters the special Gmail Trash path only for a Gmail server, a deletion flag, a model that does not show deleted messages, expunge_after_delete enabled, and a known Trash path. gExpungeAfterDelete starts false. The implementation targets removal through Trash and All Mail under the reported server behavior; this does not make ordinary Thunderbird default deletion permanent. The commit reports additional Gmail-copy visibility conditions, and no Gmail server scenario was run. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Gmail complete removal is a guarded opt-in path
